content: Vikram Singh from ProtectAll Agency calls customer Riya Mukherjee to discuss her expired health policy and the 30% premium increase due to medical inflation and maternity coverage. Riya requests to remove the maternity rider, bringing the annual cost down to 4,350 INR, and opts for a monthly payment plan of 460 INR. Vikram updates the system with a new policy number (HP-2026-0459), reviews key policy benefits, and explains the hospitalisation claim process. Vikram will follow up the next day to confirm receipt of the revised quote email.

action_items: Customer to review and confirm email quote
Agent to follow up tomorrow regarding email receipt
